verdict.rationale: Kimi's own docs describe the AI analyzing the user's own material inside the product: whole-codebase understanding with a million-token context, large codebase analysis and long-document processing, and an agent that reads a local project and verifies results through conversation. No feature is documented that turns general user data into insights or proactive suggestions, so support is limited to code and document analysis. Missing for 10: a documented data-analysis or insights feature for user data beyond code and documents, proactive suggestions, and independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: A million-token context loads an entire large codebase with cross-module dependencies in one pass, enabling whole-project understanding and refactoring.
Best for large codebase analysis, multi-file refactoring, and long-document processing.
Open a local project folder in Kimi Code Desktop and let the Agent read code, edit files, run commands, and verify results through conversation.
